description: A Minecraft mod that adds adds gradual, ragged footpaths. Walk a route often and grass wears to dirt, coarse dirt, and path, turning to mud near water

mods.name: TrailWright
mods.description: Trails wear into the ground where players, mounts, and mobs walk: grass to dirt, then coarse dirt, or mud near water. Bone meal, brushing, or planting restores it. Rules are data-driven. Server-side; optional on clients, where it adds an F3 wear readout for ops. Runs on Forge 1.20.1 through Sinytra Connector.
